verdicts.reason: A pulls all the text out of the white card, so an empty white box with two orphaned pink dots sits in the middle of the art. The headline crowds the top. 'The Minimalist' and the opening date are cramped together at the bottom, with a big dead white band above them. B has the same text split, and worse: the white card is chopped off and sticks up past the image and frame, and the pink dots float on plain white with nothing to anchor them. B's date line is also tiny, and the dead space is even larger.
